motions.name: Govern, secure and assure with AI (control plane)

otSafetyRule: No agent operates, or is promoted to operate, grid, plant or gas control devices (switching, breakers, set-points, valves, de-energisation). Any agent or process whose action would change a grid, plant, storage or gas device is capped at L2.

flagshipAgents.name: Outage Communication & ETR Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Tells every affected customer what is happening, when power will be back and what to do, on their preferred channel.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Outage created, ETR changed or restoration confirmed
guardrails: Only ETRs produced by the restoration model or a dispatcher
Medical-baseline and critical-care customers contacted first
willNot: Promise a restoration time a dispatcher has not confirmed
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: How many customers on feeder 12-04 are still out, and what have we told them?

flagshipAgents.name: High-Bill & Usage Explainer Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Explains any bill change with interval usage, weather, rate and billing-days evidence, and suggests ways to lower the next one.
flagshipAgents.trigger: High-bill contact, complaint or mid-cycle alert
guardrails: Explanations cite interval data and the rate applied
Adjustments only through billing policy
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Why is my July bill $96 higher than last year?

flagshipAgents.name: Payment Assistance & Affordability Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Finds the right payment arrangement or assistance program for customers in arrears, within regulatory protections.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Arrears threshold, customer request or disconnection list
guardrails: Medical, weather and seasonal disconnection protections checked on every account
Arrangement terms within tariff rules
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which customers in arrears qualify for assistance before the next disconnection cycle?

flagshipAgents.name: Energy Program & EV Advisor Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Matches customers to efficiency, demand-response, EV and solar programs and rates that save them money and relieve the grid.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Campaign cycle, EV detected or customer request
guardrails: Recommend only approved programs and rates
Consent required for marketing contact
willNot: Promise savings beyond the program's measured range
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which customers on constrained feeders should we invite to the EV managed-charging program?

flagshipAgents.name: Large Load & New Connection Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Screens new service and large-load requests (including data centres), gives a fast feasibility answer and drafts the next steps.
flagshipAgents.trigger: New service request or large-load inquiry
guardrails: Feasibility is indicative until engineering signs off
Large-load tariff and collateral rules applied
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Can we serve a 300 MW data centre near the Valley 345 kV substation by 2028?

flagshipAgents.name: Outage Prediction & Storm Staging Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Predicts where storms will cause outages and recommends crew, material and mutual-assistance staging.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Severe weather forecast 72 hours out
guardrails: Staging recommendations only; crews released by people
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: What damage should we expect from Thursday's storm and where should crews stage?

flagshipAgents.name: Fault Location & Restoration Advisor
flagshipAgents.mission: Combines AMI last-gasp, SCADA and fault indicators to locate faults and recommend isolation and restoration switching for the operator.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Feeder lockout or AMI outage cluster
guardrails: Switching is always executed by a qualified operator
Plans checked against the as-operated network model
willNot: Operate any switch, breaker or device
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Feeder 12-04 locked out — where is the fault and how do we restore most customers fastest?

flagshipAgents.name: Asset Health & Risk Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Scores the health and failure risk of transformers, breakers, poles and cables and ranks interventions by risk reduced per dollar.
flagshipAgents.trigger: New inspection, test result or loading event
guardrails: Every score explains its drivers
Capital changes go through the planning cycle
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which substation transformers are most likely to fail this summer?

flagshipAgents.name: Drone & Visual Inspection Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Finds defects in drone, LiDAR and thermal imagery and turns confirmed defects into prioritised work.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Imagery uploaded from an inspection flight
guardrails: High-severity findings reviewed by a qualified inspector
Images stored with location and time stamp
willNot: Close a defect without inspector review
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: What did last week's transmission line flights find on the Coastal 230 kV line?

flagshipAgents.name: Vegetation & Wildfire Risk Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Scores span-level vegetation and fire-weather risk, builds risk-based trim plans and prepares PSPS decision packs for people to decide.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Fire-weather forecast, new imagery or plan cycle
guardrails: De-energisation decisions are made only by authorised people
Customer impact (incl. medical baseline) shown in every pack
willNot: Recommend or execute de-energisation on its own
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which circuits are in the highest fire-risk tier for tomorrow's red-flag warning?

flagshipAgents.name: Work Bundling & Crew Dispatch Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Bundles nearby work, schedules crews by skill, permit and material availability, and dispatches emergencies to the best crew.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Weekly schedule or new emergency job
guardrails: Crew qualifications and hours-of-service limits enforced
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Bundle next week's pole replacements in the Central region by crew and permits.

flagshipAgents.name: Gas Leak & Integrity Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Grades and prioritises leak indications, scores excavation-damage risk and ranks pipe segments by integrity threat.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Leak survey upload or one-call ticket
guardrails: Hazardous leak response follows the emergency procedure, not the agent
Grading reviewed by a qualified technician
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which open leaks and excavation tickets need attention first today?

flagshipAgents.name: Plant Performance & Heat Rate Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Detects heat-rate drift and performance losses across the fleet and recommends corrections to operators.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Heat-rate deviation or daily performance run
guardrails: Set-point changes made by operators within operating limits
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Why did Unit 2's heat rate rise this week?

flagshipAgents.name: Generation Predictive Maintenance Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Spots early signs of equipment failure from historian data and raises evidence-backed work requests.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Anomaly score above threshold
guardrails: Work requests carry the sensor evidence
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which rotating equipment is trending toward failure across the fleet?

flagshipAgents.name: Load & Renewables Forecasting Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Forecasts load, wind and solar output with weather, DER and electrification signals.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Forecast cycle or weather update
guardrails: Forecasts published with confidence bands
Human review on extreme-weather days
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: What is tomorrow's peak load forecast and how confident are we?

flagshipAgents.name: Market Bidding & Settlement Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Prepares unit offers within the approved strategy and reconciles ISO/RTO settlements to internal data.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Bid window or settlement statement
guardrails: Offers within approved risk limits and market rules
Disputes filed by people
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Where did last month's settlement differ from our meter data?

flagshipAgents.name: Battery Storage Dispatch Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Optimises battery charge and discharge against prices, grid constraints and state-of-health limits.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Day-ahead and real-time price updates
guardrails: Schedules executed by the EMS/operator, not the agent
Degradation limits always respected
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: How much value did our batteries capture during last week's heat wave?

flagshipAgents.name: Data Product Discovery Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Turns business intent plus report and KPI lineage from the BI estate into a ranked, evidence-backed data-product backlog.
flagshipAgents.trigger: New intent or BI rationalisation run
guardrails: Propose-only
Every recommendation cites lineage evidence
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: We need to cut SAIDI — which data products do we need?

flagshipAgents.name: Source-to-Target Mapping Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Maps CIS, MDMS, OMS, GIS, EAM and historian sources to the utility data model (CIM-aligned) with confidence scores.
flagshipAgents.trigger: New source or schema drift
dataProducts: Source schemas (CIS, MDMS, OMS, ADMS, GIS, EAM, historian)
guardrails: Mappings below 0.8 confidence need review
Customer energy usage data and CEII auto-classified
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Map the new MDMS interval feed to Customer 360 and the outage data product.

flagshipAgents.name: Data Quality Rules Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Generates and backtests quality rules for critical data elements such as meter IDs, premise-to-transformer links and outage times.
flagshipAgents.trigger: New product, CDE or quality incident
guardrails: Rules backtested on 13 months before activation
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Create quality rules for meter-to-transformer connectivity and outage start/end times.

flagshipAgents.name: Pipeline & Code Generation Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Generates and tests transformation code from approved mappings and opens a pull request for human merge.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Mapping approved
guardrails: Human-approved pull requests only
CI tests must pass
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Generate the Silver-to-Gold model for outage events with major-event-day flags.

flagshipAgents.name: Semantic Model Builder Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Builds semantic views and verified queries for certified KPIs such as SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI, O&M per customer and bad debt.
flagshipAgents.trigger: KPI certified or product published
guardrails: Every metric references a certified KPI definition (e.g. IEEE 1366)
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Build the semantic view for reliability metrics with and without major event days.

flagshipAgents.name: GIS & Network Model Quality Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Finds connectivity, phasing and asset-record errors using AMI voltage correlation and as-built reconciliation.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Nightly model check or work order closed
guardrails: Fixes applied by GIS editors after review
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which meters are probably connected to the wrong transformer in the Metro region?

flagshipAgents.name: Data Quality & Healing Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Monitors data products, detects freshness and quality breaches and applies catalogued fixes before consumers notice.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Freshness SLA miss, rule breach or schema drift
guardrails: Auto-fix only for catalogued patterns
Consumers notified
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: The AMI interval feed is late this morning — what broke and who is affected?

flagshipAgents.name: Platform FinOps Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Attributes compute, storage and model cost to data products, agents and outcomes and recommends savings.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Daily cost run or budget threshold
guardrails: Changes within approved budget envelopes
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which workloads cost the most per outage restored this month?

flagshipAgents.name: Ask the Utility Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Answers business questions over certified data products with a full 'how I answered' trace, refusing when evidence is missing.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Question in chat, BI or mobile
guardrails: Row and column policies applied
Refuses rather than answers without evidence
willNot: Reveal customer energy usage data or CEII to uncleared roles
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: What was SAIDI excluding major event days last quarter by region?

flagshipAgents.name: Marketplace Concierge Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Helps users find, preview and request the right data product or agent.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Marketplace search or data question
guardrails: Previews use masked samples only
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: I need feeder loading by month for the Valley region — where do I get it?

flagshipAgents.name: Executive Insight Briefing Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Produces a weekly, cited briefing on reliability, safety, customer, cost and capital-plan KPIs with drivers and actions.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Weekly schedule or KPI threshold breach
guardrails: Certified KPIs only; every claim cited
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Brief me on reliability, safety and O&M per customer last week.

flagshipAgents.name: Agent Evaluation & Promotion Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Runs evaluation suites, tracks acceptance and recommends promoting or demoting each agent's autonomy.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Nightly evaluation or threshold crossed
guardrails: Promotion by human decision only
OT-facing agents capped at L2
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Which agents are eligible for promotion this month?

flagshipAgents.name: Access Request Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Evaluates access requests against purpose, role and classification; auto-approves within policy and routes the rest.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Access request submitted
guardrails: Customer energy usage data, CEII and critical-infrastructure data always need owner approval
Access time-boxed
willNot: Approve restricted data without the owner
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Request read access to Outage & Reliability 360 for a performance report.

flagshipAgents.name: Field Safety Briefing Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Builds a job-specific pre-job briefing from work type, location, weather, energy sources and past incidents, and answers crew safety questions.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Job dispatched or crew question
guardrails: Briefing supports, never replaces, the crew's own tailboard
High-energy hazards always listed first
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Brief my crew on tomorrow's underground cable splice at Main and 4th.

flagshipAgents.name: Rate Case & Data Request Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Drafts responses to regulator data requests and checks filings for inconsistent numbers, all from certified data.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Data request or filing draft
guardrails: Every figure traces to a certified source
Responses reviewed by the witness
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Draft the response to staff's data request on vegetation spend per mile since 2022.

flagshipAgents.name: Critical-Infrastructure Compliance Evidence Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Collects and indexes reliability and cyber-standards evidence continuously and flags gaps before audits.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Control test cycle or configuration change
guardrails: Read-only on critical-infrastructure systems
Evidence handled under information-protection rules
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Are we audit-ready for the critical-infrastructure protection controls this quarter?

flagshipAgents.name: Long-Lead Materials Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Forecasts transformer, meter, cable and switchgear demand from the capital plan, failures and storms, and re-plans when suppliers slip.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Planning cycle or supplier delay
guardrails: Allocation changes within budget
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Will we have enough pad-mount transformers for the Q1 new-service backlog?

flagshipAgents.name: Capital Plan Optimisation Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Ranks capital projects by risk reduced, reliability gained and customer bill impact within budget and resource limits.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Capital planning cycle
guardrails: Portfolio decisions made by the investment committee
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: What portfolio gives the most SAIDI improvement for the same capital budget?

flagshipAgents.name: Customer Data Privacy & Consent Agent
flagshipAgents.mission: Checks that consent and customer-data-sharing rules propagate to every system, partner and agent that uses customer energy data.
flagshipAgents.trigger: Consent change or new data use
guardrails: Read-only on customer records
flagshipAgents.demoPrompt: Has every system honoured the data-sharing opt-outs received last week?
